title: BuildCode
description: The JSON inside a simulator build code. A build code is this JSON, gzipped, then base64 encoded (standard alphabet; URL-encoding is undone first). The shape mirrors the umalator's page state, so its field names, enums and value ranges match it; the fields marked as uma.moe additions are what the Skill planner needs beyond that. Unknown fields are kept and ignored.

version.description: uma.moe addition. The build code version; 1 for this schema. Absent in umalator state.

courseId.description: The simulator course_id, such as 10611 for Tokyo dirt 1,600 m.

mode.description: uma.moe addition. What the Skill planner plans for: a Champions Meeting race or a Team Trials distance.

opponents.description: uma.moe addition, no longer read. Who the Skill planner raced her against before it raced her alone: the leading teams of a CM (cm), eight copies of her (mirror), or the race sim field (field). Kept so older codes still validate.

cmSnapshot.description: uma.moe addition, no longer read. The CM Data dataset whose leading teams she raced, for opponents cm. Kept so older codes still validate.

tracks.description: uma.moe addition. For the tt_* modes: the courses Team Trials draws from, as simulator course_ids. The Skill planner races one of them per race, as the game draws a course per match. Absent means every JRA course of the distance (turf of that distance type, or dirt).

scoring.description: uma.moe addition, no longer read. Team Trials scoring from before the Skill planner scored builds on the time they save; kept so older codes still validate.

supportCardBonus.description: Support card bonus, as the Team Trials screen shows it.

uma1.description: The runner: at the end of a career for the Skill planner, or the first runner elsewhere.

uma2.description: A second runner; the race simulator adds it to the field when it differs from uma1.

chartSkills.description: The skills on offer: what uma1 can buy with her skill points. Skill ids as strings.

hintLevels.description: Hint level per skill id, 0 to 5. Each level takes 10, 20, 30, 35 or 40% off that skill's cost. Missing skills have no hint.

race.description: Race conditions, as the game numbers them.

season.description: 1 spring, 2 summer, 3 autumn, 4 winter, 5 cherry blossom (raced as spring).

grade.description: Race grade, such as 100 for G1. Not used by the simulator.

outfitId.description: The trainee's card id, as a string, such as "102602".

strategy.description: Running style: Nige front, Senkou pace, Sasi late, Oikomi end, Oonige runaway.

distanceAptitude.description: Her distance aptitude on courseId; wins over the matching aptitudes entry.

surfaceAptitude.description: Her surface aptitude on courseId; wins over the matching aptitudes entry.

strategyAptitude.description: Her aptitude for her strategy; wins over the matching aptitudes entry.

aptitudes.description: All ten aptitudes: short, mile, medium, long; nige, senkou, sasi, oikomi; turf, dirt.

skills.description: The skills she has, her unique included.

popularity.description: Gate popularity. Not used by the simulator.

sp.description: uma.moe addition. Skill points left to spend: the Skill planner's budget.

fans.description: uma.moe addition. Her fan count; skills that grow with fans need it.

fastLearner.description: uma.moe addition. Fast Learner: another 10% off every skill.
